paragraphs: In the morning, receive assignments, research statutes, and gather cases. Around midday, write a first draft and align its position with the lawyer. Before organizing evidence, review deadlines and revise the materials several times. In the afternoon, coordinate with courts or clients and supplement materials. Before leaving, archive documents and organize the next day's milestones.

In short: put legal work on paper. Tasks include research, drafting, file organization, deadline management, liaison, and archiving. It combines intellectual and hands-on work on the front line of legal operations.
